amend_reason.title: amend_reason
amend_reason.description:
Specification of amendment reason
MD16-Requested By Customer
MD17-Requested By Initiating Party
MD18-Requested By Initiating Party And Customer
MS02-Not Specified Reason Customer
MS03-Not Specified Reason Agent Generated
MSUC-Mandate suspended after 7 consecutive unsuccessful collections
NARR- Reason is provided as narrative information

name.title: name
name.description: Specify the name by which a party is known and which is used to identify that party. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

address_1.title: address_1
address_1.description: Specify the address of the party who involves in the payment flow. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

address_2.title: address_2
address_2.description: Specify the address of the party who involves in the payment flow. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

address_3.title: address_3
address_3.description: Specify the address of the party who involves in the payment flow. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

country_code.title: country_code
country_code.description: Specify the country code of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

postal_code.title: postal_code
postal_code.description: Specify the postal code of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

town_name.title: town_name
town_name.description: Specify the town name of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

mobile_number.title: mobile_number
mobile_number.description: Specify the mobile number of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

fax_number.title: fax_number
fax_number.description: Specify the fax number of the creditor address. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

email.title: email
email.description: Specify the Address for electronic mail (e-mail). This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

other_identification_category.title: other_identification_category
other_identification_category.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification of a party. The value will be either `ORG` or `PVT`. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

other_identification_type.title: other_identification_type
other_identification_type.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous way to identify an organization/private identification. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

other_identification.title: other_identification
other_identification.description: Specify the value of an organization/private identification. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

iban.title: iban
iban.description: An identifier used internationally by financial institutions to uniquely identify the account of a customer at a financial institution, as described in the latest edition of the international standard ISO 13616: 2007 - Banking and related financial services - International Bank Account Number (IBAN). This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

bank_routing_code.title: bank_routing_code
bank_routing_code.description: Specify the Code allocated to a financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC). For Australia this parameter is not allowed to amend.

bank_branch_code.title: bank_branch_code
bank_branch_code.description: Specify the 6-digit BSB/9-digit account identification assigned by the Entity. For Australia this parameter is not allowed to amend.

scheme_identification.title: scheme_identification
scheme_identification.description: Specify the  originator Creditor Scheme Identifier. This parameter is not applicable for Australia.

account.title: account
account.description: Specify the unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a debit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

account_type.title: account_type
account_type.description:
Specify the name of the identification scheme, in a coded form as published in an external list.
AIIN -Issuer Identification Number
BBAN- BBAN Identifier
CUID -CHIPS Universal Identifier
UPIC- UPIC Identifier
ALIA-Alias (proxy). For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

proxy_id.title: proxy_id
proxy_id.description: Specify the Identification used to indicate the account identification under another specified name. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

proxy_type.title: proxy_type
proxy_type.description:
Specify the name of the identification scheme, in a coded form as published in an external list. Specify the value only when the mandate request is other than the payer (debtor) account number:
TELE-TelephoneNumber
EMAL-EmailAddress
DNAM-DomainName
CINC-CertificateOfIncorporationNumber
COTX-CorporateTaxIdentification
COID-CountryAuthorityIdentification
CUST-CustomerIdentificationNumber
DRLC-DriverLicenseNumber
EIDN-ElectronicIdentification
EWAL-EWalletIdentification
PVTX-IndividualTaxIdentification
LEIC-LegalEntityIdentifierCode
MBNO-MobilePhoneNumber
NIDN-NationalIdentificationNumber
CCPT-PassportNumber
SHID-SchemeIdentificationNumber
SOSE-SocialSecurityNumber
TOKN-TokenIdentification
UBIL-UtilitiesSubscriptionIdentification
VIPN-VehicleIdentificationPlateNumber
BIID-BillerSubscriberIdentification. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

name.title: name
name.description: Specify the name by which a party is known and which is used to identify that party. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

account.title: account
account.description: Specify the unique identification of an account, as assigned by the account servicer, using an identification scheme. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

other_identification_category.title: other_identification_category
other_identification_category.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification of a party. the value will be organization/Private. For Australia this parameter is not allowed to amend.

other_identification_type.title: other_identification_type
other_identification_type.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous type to identify an organization/private identification. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

other_identification.title: other_identification
other_identification.description: Specify the value of an organization/private identification type. For Australia this parameter is not allowed to amend.

bank_routing_code.title: bank_routing_code
bank_routing_code.description: Specify the unique identification of an organization, as assigned by an institution, using an identification scheme. For Australia this parameter is not allowed to amend.

becs_user_identification.title: becs_user_identification
becs_user_identification.description: BECS user ID related to migrated DDR mandate. For Australia this parameter is not allowed to amend.

country.title: country
country.description:
Specify the country code where the mandate request has been originated.
Australia = AU
Hongkong = HK
Argentina = AR
SEPA = UK

mandate_description.title: mandate_description
mandate_description.description:
Specify the description of the reason for mandate setup as narrative text.
This parameter is specific to Australia. both mandate_description and mandate_additional_ information parameters are expected to be sent by client for Australia. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

sequence_type.title: sequence_type
sequence_type.description: Specify the underlying transaction sequence as either recurring or one-off. For Australia this parameter is not allowed to amend.

payment_frequency.title: payment_frequency
payment_frequency.description:
Specify the regularity of an event.
ADHO = Ad hoc (Event takes place on request or as necessary)
DAIL = Daily (Event takes place every day)
FRTN = Fortnightly (Event takes place every two weeks)
INDA = Intraday (Event takes place several times a day)
MIAN = Semiannual (Event takes place every six months or two times a year)
MNTH = Monthly (Event takes place every month)
QURT = Quarterly (Event takes place every three months)
WEEK = Weekly (Event takes place once a week)
YEAR = Annual (Event takes place every year or once a year) For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally

count_per_period.title: count_per_period
count_per_period.description: Specify the frequency in terms of the number of instructions to be created and processed during the specified period. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

point_in_time.title: point_in_time
point_in_time.description: Specify the frequency in terms of an exact point in time or moment within the specified period. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

tracking_indicator.title: tracking_indicator
tracking_indicator.description: Specify the indicating value either True or False, whether the direct debit instructions should be automatically re-submitted periodically when bilaterally agreed. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

mandate_additional_information.title: mandate_additional_information
mandate_additional_information.description: Specify the additional information in free text form to complement the mandate information. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

payment_execution_not_before_time.title: payment_execution_not_before_time
payment_execution_not_before_time.description: Indicates that each execution of the mandate payment should not occur before a given time(hh:mm:ss.sssZ) of that execution day. This parameter is specific to Australia. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

transfer_arrangement.title: transfer_arrangement
transfer_arrangement.description: Indication of future transfer date, conditions of sale and requirement to hold funds. This parameter is specific to Australia. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

resolution_requested_by.title: resolution_requested_by
resolution_requested_by.description: Time used to indicate by when resolution of a bilateral action is requested from the other party to the mandate. This parameter is specific to Australia. For Australia, this parameter is not allowed to amend.

service_id.title: service_id
service_id.description: specify a pre-agreed service or level of service between the parties. This parameter is mandatory for Australia. For Australia, this parameter is not allowed to amend unilaterally.

instruction_priority.title: instruction_priority
instruction_priority.description: Specifies the priority level of an event. For Australia This parameter is not allowed to amend.

mandate_start_date.title: mandate_start_date
mandate_start_date.description: Start date of the validity of the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format. For Australia, this parameter is not allowed for amendment.

mandate_expiry_date.title: mandate_expiry_date
mandate_expiry_date.description: Specify the End date of the validity of the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

mandate_first_collection_date.title: mandate_first_collection_date
mandate_first_collection_date.description: Specify the Date of the first collection of a direct debit as per the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

mandate_final_collection_date.title: mandate_final_collection_date
mandate_final_collection_date.description: Specify the Date of the final collection of a direct debit as per the mandate. Calender year expressed in the YYYY-MM-DD format. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

mandate_type.title: mandate_type
mandate_type.description: Specify the type of mandate. For Australia This parameter is not allowed to amend.

mandate_scheme.title: mandate_scheme
mandate_scheme.description: Specify the arrangement (unilateral or bilateral) and the party that established the mandate. For Australia This parameter is not allowed to amend.

mandate_purpose.title: mandate_purpose
mandate_purpose.description: Specify the high-level purpose of the mandate. For Australia This parameter is not allowed to amend.

payment_amount_type.title: payment_amount_type
payment_amount_type.description:
Specify the mandate payment arrangement.
FIXE -Fixed Direct debit amount is fixed.
USGB -Usage Based Direct debit amount is based on usage.
VARI -Variable Direct debit amount is variable
BALN- Balloon Payment. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

debtor_reference_number.title: debtor_reference_number
debtor_reference_number.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification as assigned by the creditor to the referred document shared with the debtor for its own reference. For Australia, this parameter is not allowed to amend.

debtor_code.title: debtor_code
debtor_code.description: Specify the Proprietary identification of the type of the remittance document. For Australia, this parameter is not allowed to amend.

creditor_reference_number.title: creditor_reference_number
creditor_reference_number.description: Specify the unique and unambiguous identification as assigned by the debtor to the referred document shared with the creditor for its own reference. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.

payment_reference_number.title: payment_reference_number
payment_reference_number.description: Specify the proprietary identification of the type of the remittance document. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

currency.title: currency
currency.description: Specify the collection account currency. For Australia, this parameter is not allowed to amend.

amount.title: amount
amount.description: Specify the Fixed amount to be collected from the debtor’s account. For Australia if payment_amount_type parameter is equal to FIXE then this parameter is mandatory. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

maximum_amount.title: maximum_amount
maximum_amount.description: Specify the Maximum amount to be collected from the debtors account, per instruction. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

first_collection_amount.title: first_collection_amount
first_collection_amount.description: Specify the first collection amount to be collected from the debtors account. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

final_collection_amount.title: final_collection_amount
final_collection_amount.description: Specify the final collection amount to be collected from the debtors account. For Australia this parameter is allowed to amend bilaterally.

cummulative_amount.title: cummulative_amount
cummulative_amount.description: Specify the cumulative fixed amount to be collected from the debtors account. This parameter is not applicable to Australia.

ultimate_creditor_name.title: ultimate_creditor_name
ultimate_creditor_name.description: Specify the name by which the ultimate creditor is known and which is used to identify that party. For Australia, this parameter is allowed to amend unilaterally.
